role: Comparator that orders WorldRenderer sections for RenderGlobal.sortAndRender: in-frustum sections after out-of-frustum ones, then by descending squared distance to the camera entity, then by descending chunk index.
scope_reason: Draw order determines the compared pixels for overlapping translucent geometry.

members.name: baseEntity
members.note: the camera entity; the native sort measures from the camera position

members.name: compare
members.note: RenderSorter only orders RenderGlobal.updateRenderers' rebuild list (RenderGlobal.java:1623), which chunks rebuild first within the frame's budget; the oracle's agent frames rebuild every dirty chunk before drawing (EntityRenderer.java:1291, oracleSyncForCamera and the updateRenderers loop), as the native live pipeline remeshes every stale section, so the order leaves no trace in a frame. The draw order is EntitySorter's (live_water_compare for the translucent pass)

notes: RenderSorter is used for the opaque sortAndRender path in vanilla; the live pipeline draws opaque sections in chunk order and applies the distance sort to the translucent (water) list, which is where order changes pixels. raster.c's comment at live_water_compare says 'Java sorts the translucent renderers with a stable sort: equal distances keep the square's own order'.
